title: GroceryCategory
description: Schema for a single grocery category definition in the personal grocery research tool.

id.description: Snake_case identifier, e.g. meat_protein, dairy, protein_powder

description.description: One-sentence description of what this category covers

automatic_checks.description: Rules applied automatically — no user input required. Applied to every product before it can qualify.

rule.description: Plain-language description of the check logic

applies_to.description: Which subcategories this check applies to. Use ['all'] to apply universally.

pass_condition.description: What must be true for the product to pass this check

flag_if_fail.description: Message shown in report if the product fails this check

certifications.description: Relevant certifications or standards. Where none exists, an ingredient/label rule substitutes.

applies_when.description: When this certification is relevant, e.g. 'organic toggle selected' or 'always'

logo_text.description: How the certification appears on label

note.description: Important caveats — especially unregulated marketing terms that mimic this cert

toggle_options.description: Multiple-choice tradeoff decisions presented to user. Only include where a real tradeoff exists.

applies_to_subcategory.description: Which subcategory this toggle applies to. Use 'all' if universal.

required.description: If true, user must select before research runs. If false, skippable with a default applied.

best_for.description: One-liner for who this option suits

subcategories.description: List of specific item types within this category

edge_case_rules.description: Fallback behavior when no qualifying product exists

report_fields.description: Fields to include for each product result in the PDF report
